summary: In the Ansible extension choose ADD > Devcontainer with the Downstream image to create Podman and Docker devcontainer.json files, then Reopen in Container; the UBI Minimal image has microdnf only, no dnf or yum.
questions: How do I create a devcontainer for Ansible in VS Code?
Why is dnf missing in the Ansible dev container?
How do I reopen my project in the Ansible dev container?
